source_description: The Cliffside Renewal Escape includes a two-night stay in a sea-view suite, breakfast for two each morning, and one 60-minute massage per registered adult guest. Available Sunday through Thursday from 1 October to 18 December 2026, excluding 26–29 November. The package is for two registered adults. Breakfast is served in the Terrace Dining Room, and massages take place at the Cliffside Spa. Advance booking of spa appointments is required at least 72 hours before arrival. The package cannot be combined with other offers.
